title: A Two-Channel F-Transform Representation for Early Trajectory Characterization in Iterated Correlation Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2606.05462v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many nonlinear iterative systems generate high-dimensional trajectories whose early behavior is informative but difficult to compare directly. This paper derives a fixed-dimensional F-transform coordinate representation for early trajectories of iterated Pearson correlation matrices. The construction is defined on the first five-point post-transient signal window, which is the shortest sampled window that simultaneously places the three symmetric fuzzy nodes at observed positions and supports a nondegenerate centered first-degree F-transform coefficient, thereby providing the earliest feasible local level--trend characterization within this sampled geometry. The representation combines two logarithmic observables of the post-transient dynamics: step size and contraction ratio. Applying this same four-coordinate construction to the step-size and contraction-ratio signals yields the eight-dimensional descriptor $\Psi=(v_1,v_2,v_3

translated_title: 迭代相关动力学早期轨迹表征的双通道F-变换表示
translated_abstract: 许多非线性迭代系统生成高维轨迹，其早期行为具有信息价值但难以直接比较。本文为迭代Pearson相关矩阵的早期轨迹推导了一种固定维度的F-变换坐标表示。该构造定义在首个五点瞬态后信号窗口上，这是同时将三个对称模糊节点置于观测位置并支持非退化中心一阶F-变换系数的最短采样窗口，从而在此采样几何中提供最早的可行局部水平-趋势表征。该表示结合了瞬态后动力学的两个对数观测量：步长和收缩比。将相同的四坐标构造应用于步长和收缩比信号，得到八维描述符$\Psi=(v_1,v_2,v_3...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于双通道F-变换的固定维度表示方法，通过步长和收缩比的对数观测在最短采样窗口内实现迭代相关动力学早期轨迹的局部水平-趋势特征提取。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fixed-dimensional two-channel F-transform representation that extracts early local level-trend features of iterated correlation dynamics via logarithmic observables of step size and contraction ratio within the shortest feasible sampling window.
